description.html: The 30x30x50 cm terrarium is a vertical model of about 45 liters, with a 3D styrofoam background and mesh ventilation. Half a meter of height on a 30x30 cm base is the size most often chosen for a single adult crested gecko. It fits on a dresser or a shelf 30 cm deep, provided there is room above for a lamp.

Half a meter of height divides into three bands: a damper bottom with substrate, a middle with branches and an upper part with plants where the gecko sleeps during the day. A gargoyle gecko spends more time on thicker branches and the background. For day geckos and green anoles, a lamp above the mesh creates a warm spot near the top, and frogs choose the lower, damper half.

We build the same format without a 3D background with film, for example with a Serbian flag motif. The taller variant is the 30x30x55, and the wider one the 45x40x70. Changes to dimensions are made by agreement, with a lead time of 7 to 14 days and shipping by courier. We make the background in the shape of rock or bark, according to the species you keep.
